text:
sasha: quick heads-up from canary: after leader shuffle some hot prefixes were evicted then immediately refetched. suspect handoff leaves nodes with inconsistent recency state. idea: include a small Ticket (node_id + counter) on residency plus an access_epoch. eviction orders by (access_epoch, ticket) with a short soft-pin on freshly transferred prefixes.

mike: ticket namespace? node-local or global? wrap concerns?

sasha: node-local 64-bit counter + node id. on restart node emits tombstone with last counter; other nodes treat older counters as expired. wrap is impractical.

anna: how avoid stale ticket keeping a prefix forever?

sasha: access_epoch bumped on access; comparator prefers higher epoch. ticket only tie-breaks. also soft-pin window on new transfers.

jordan: race: eviction at source during transfer?

sasha: sketch handshake: source marks TRANSFERRING + last_ticket, dest pulls+ACKs, source clears after ACK. eviction defers if TRANSFERRING set or times out.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: FYI kv-cache/evict-ticket-sim flaky in CI, recent failure seed https://ci.internal/12345

mike: good. sasha, please open RFC + tests (comparator unit tests, tombstone recovery, chaos failover).
